equations.audit: Flowchart uses original residual instead; how K correlations reduce to one scalar and max/min direction not fully specified.
Missing numerical epsilon/affine terms as schematic; does not transform an arbitrary distribution into Gaussian as Figure3 wording suggests.
Printed x(t+r*k), positive future indices for forward time; reverse indexing/padding would require definition. Not proof actual code leaks.
Both zmax/zmin described as maximum of normalized predictions, rather than training original-scale extrema; wind-power wording in load study.
Absolute value omitted; printed expression is signed percentage error. Implementation unknown.
Text claims range0-1, but formula permits negatives; EVS is not R2 and must not be subjected to the R2/MSE identity audit.

tables.audit: Full best overall errors, but MLP withoutTFE worsensMAPE and TCN afterTFE worsensMAPE. M3/M7 share RMSE/MAE despite differentMAPE/EVS; identity alone not impossible.

p20 direction words reversed: Full has lower errors/higherEVS thanM8/9, not increased errors/decreasedEVS. Full slower thanM8, faster thanM9. M10-M8 MAPE=.305pp andM11-M9=.119pp, not printed.308/.477.
IVY-S SA smallMAPE difference.033pp,EVS ties at3decimals; no repeated seeds to establish reliable optimizer superiority.
Full best errors, not fastest; comparison toReformer MAPE gap2.705pp correct,Autoformer4.974pp correct;EVS relative increase overTransformer≈11.07%, not9.969% which uses final denominator.

experiments.strength: All eight configurations exist; can support descriptive conditional effects
experiments.limit: No reported factorial main/interaction statistics, seeds or uncertainty; TFE groups Prophet and optimizedVMD, does not isolate holiday/IMF component contributions.
STL-VMD name does not establish equalVMD tuning; preprocessing fit boundary unspecified.
No detailed matched evaluation counts, selectedK/alpha per optimizer, convergence traces or repeated stochastic runs.
Same generic hyperparameters are not equal optimal tuning or capacity; common grid search claimed but grid/configuration budgets absent.

statistics.sample_count: 140256 equals1461days*96 over2020-2023; timezone/DST treatment not given
statistics.split: 70%train20%test10%validation; chronology/boundary dates and preprocessing fit scope not reported
statistics.leakage_status: Whole-series component plots do not prove leakage, but train-only Prophet fit/IVY objective and rolling VMD at forecast origin are not documented; confirmation needed
statistics.point_metrics: RMSE/MAE/MAPE/EVS plusruntime; no horizon-wise errors or interval calibration
statistics.significance: No seed counts,repeated trials,confidence intervals,formal tests,correction or inferential effect sizes
statistics.runtime: Reported seconds per configuration; whether includes Prophet,IVY search,data prep and tuning unclear; no peak memory/FLOPs
statistics.accuracy_label: 98.138% is100-MAPE1.862, not classification accuracy or probability of correct forecasts
statistics.source_code: p24 names github.com/Whztever/Time-Series-Library_YAML; existence/current contents and version not inspected in this case

narrative.pattern: Need for stable smart energy -> insufficient feature extraction -> staged hybrid design -> feature visualizations -> module,feature,optimizer,system comparisons -> broad superiority -> complexity/generalization caveats
narrative.strength: Four experimental families align with levels of the pipeline; common model register makes comparisons traceable
risks: Repeated adjectives such as superior/robust/meticulously without uncertainty
SSA centralized coordination/single-point-failure criticism not supported by a distributed-system analysis
Statistical methods all restricted tolinear relationships is overgeneralized
Causal explanation of optimizer differences asserted without convergence/fitness evidence
Wind-power wording appears inload preprocessing andoverall experiment
Multiple figure references off byone andFigure13caption wrong
narrative.safe_transfer: Map each claimed innovation to a comparison family, preserve negative metric changes and distinguish improvement pp from relative percent.

conclusion.boundary: Authors explicitly reserve other-region evaluation for future work; no established general applicability.
